verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Azure supports the building blocks for unattended automation. Docs recommend curl in unattended scripts for DevOps automation, the CLI can be driven by scripts, and managed identities let applications get tokens without handling credentials, which suits background jobs. There is no evidence of a native scheduler or background automation runner, so the autonomous-execution part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/triggering of background jobs (e.g. Automation/Logic Apps/Functions timers), evidence of autonomous agent-driven workflows, independent hands-on corroboration.
